title_sq: Ambjent komercial per shitje prane Pazarit te Ri!
description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje ambient komercial prane pazarit te ri tek qendra Linkoln.
Me hyrje te dedikuar ambienti dodhet ne katin e pare te nje pallati te ri ndertim i vitit 2021.
Ka siperfaqe 59 m2 dhe planimetri kuadratike.
Ambjenti eshte Open Space dhe eshte shume i pershtatshem per zyra, klinika, sallone estetike etj.
Jeni te mirepritur per nje vizite ne prone.
title_en: Commercial premises for sale near the New Market!
description_en: We offer for sale commercial premises near the new shopping center in Lincoln. With a dedicated entrance, the environment is on the first floor of a new building built in 2021. It has an area of ​​59 m2 and a square layout. The environment is Open Space and is very suitable for offices, clinics, aesthetic salons, etc. You are welcome for a visit to the property.
